market_summary: During the London session, all five symbols exhibit range-bound mean-reversion or post-extension consolidation inside their session Value Areas. Assets are either magnetically pinned to their session POCs (GBPUSD, BTCUSD) or consolidating near major structural levels (US100 sweeping Session Low, XAUUSD and XAGUSD holding above VAL) without confirming RVOL > 2.0 breakout volume. A disciplined HOLD stance is maintained across the board until high-volume liquidity expansion emerges in the London-NY overlap.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and trading below the POC at 3896.98. In the LONDON_SESSION, the trend remains structurally bearish below descending VWAP (3902.82) and EMA50 (3901.22). Candles are positioned mid-channel between the EMA20 baseline and lower ATR band (3884.96). RVOL is normal at 0.965 with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout spike. Price is consolidating above S/R 3887.45 and Session Low 3878.91 without VAL expansion. GEX is null.
signals.level_event: rejection of Session High, consolidation above S/R 3887.45

signals.rationale: Price has mean-reverted inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32271 to VAH 1.32378) directly onto the session POC at 1.32349. During the LONDON_SESSION, price is tightly coiled around both VWAP (1.32325) and the EMA50 baseline (1.32346). Price is mid-channel between the upper ATR band (1.32440) and lower ATR band (1.32211). Volume is moderate with RVOL at 1.386, lacking a yellow RVOL > 2.0 confirmation spike. Following an upper wick sweep of resistance at S/R 1.32391 and the Session High (1.32431), price is stuck at fair value without momentum. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral compressed around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28165.06 to VAH 28409.31) and trading well below the POC at 28266.25. CVD is -1.78 with a NEUTRAL label and negative slope (-0.53). In this LONDON_SESSION, price remains firmly bearish below descending VWAP (28327.15) and EMA50 (28285.07). GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 49.748 to VAH 50.470) and trading below the POC at 50.049. CVD is -114 with a BEARISH label and negative slope (-32.13), agreeing with the intraday downtrend. During the LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below downward-sloping VWAP (50.228) and EMA50 (50.205). The signal candle tested near the lower ATR band (49.710) and VAL before the forming bar pulled back toward S/R resistance at 49.922. RVOL is 1.55 with no yellow RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation. Trapped between VAL support and overhead S/R resistance within the Value Area, the setup lacks clean expansion potential toward Session Low 49.579. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 67782.90 to VAH 70268.28), stabilizing right at the POC at 68676.09. CVD is -0.04 with a BEARISH label and flat slope (0.0), showing exhausted momentum after earlier session declines from Session High (71433.30). In the LONDON_SESSION, price is below both the falling VWAP (69429.72) and EMA50 baseline (69840.28). Candles are positioned mid-channel near the EMA20 baseline (68946.22), far from the lower ATR band (68189.32). Volume is low with RVOL at 0.828 without any yellow breakout spikes. Price is accepted at the POC magnet well above the Session Low at 67549.90, presenting a chop regime without directional edge. GEX is null.
